authority.grant_scope_requested: Standing Runtime 008: Runtime 007's target, reconnect backoff, reclaim storm guard, receive-only ButtonProbe and raw-send/target prohibitions, with the pages dashboard (UI-1 lightning) and slots carried in ONE streaming_ack_clock Host session per connection (600 s / 15000 frames, Host floor 40 ms, 50 ms client floor + 45 ms Host-anchored gap, one frame in flight, no pipelining), Host-confirmed yield reclaim and fresh unique bounded sessions. Adding or changing a page changes code hashes and needs a fresh reviewed revision and grant.
authority.revocation: scripts/cutover_runtime_008.sh --rollback restores Runtime 007's source and local policy exactly, then restarts the service

behavior.collector_ownership: product runtime collects while connected and while backing off; standalone collector timer is transactionally disabled and restored on uninstall

build.host_note: Unchanged Runtime 007 Host (first-frame 10 ms spacing); no Host or webcam change in Runtime 008.

description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build. Runtime 004 re-binds the policy to the Host build with a separate streaming-profile ceiling. Runtime 006 adds physical-button pagination: the Ditoo's left/right arrows page through a wrap-around list (dashboard first), a short lever pull runs the current page's own action, input from the receive-only ButtonProbe (SMTC, mirror status) run as a child of the product. Runtime 007: Host re-bind only: the candidate Host sends every session's FIRST frame with the proven 10 ms packet spacing (first-frame IMAGE_RX_RECV_TIMEOUT: 5/19 streaming_ack_clock opens vs 0/199 activity opens, captures/OPENDITOO-STREAMING-FIRST-FRAME-TIMEOUT-ANALYSIS-2026-09-10.json); later frames keep the profile spacing. Build is path-independent (PathMap). Runtime 008 (HF-4): every page (dashboard with the UI-1 lightning pulse, three-reel slots) in ONE streaming_ack_clock Host session (PageCarousel); Left/Right change pixels only; InteractiveTransport pacing (50 ms client floor + 45 ms Host-anchored gap); Host-confirmed stock yield reclaims the same page; hidden-page collection on a joined worker. Accepted as OPENDITOO-INTERACTIVE-HF3-008 (11 cycles, 66/66 inputs, 0 faults).

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

pages.lever: stop the next reel; after the third, start a new round
pages.name: slots

broker.lifetime: child of the product runtime; ends with it (webcam suspend, uninstall, stop); restarted at most every 5 s if it dies
broker.media_keys: while running, Windows media keys (Prev/Next/Play/Pause) page the Ditoo; YouTube contention PASS (BTN-8a); Spotify untested

navigation.lever_candidate: current page's lever action; long holds are never mapped (BTN-7)
navigation.nav_left: previous page, wrapping, pixels only (same Host session)
navigation.nav_right: next page, wrapping, pixels only (same Host session)
